overall_summary: Analysis of the historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics, specifically husband-wife bonding and marital realities, significantly outperform generic poetry, sad quotes, or family member tributes by nearly 6x to 10x in views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,678 views) achieved the highest engagement and view counts by a wide margin.
winning_patterns.action: Prioritize content focusing on modern marriage realities, communication gaps between partners, and subtle emotional shifts in relationships.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' performed well with 392 views compared to generic poetry like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा' which only got 21 views.
winning_patterns.action: Frame hooks around everyday relationship compromises and unspoken emotional burdens rather than abstract sad thoughts.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 21 views, showing low initial click-through and swipe-away behavior.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or cryptic phrasing in titles and hooks; keep the language conversational and rooted in everyday observation.

weak_patterns.evidence: Duplicate sister-focused videos ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 and 139 views.
weak_patterns.action: Limit standalone family tribute repetitions unless tied to a unique conflict or psychological insight.
